name: mini-agent-mcp

tools.name: calculator
tools.description: Evaluate a mathematical expression safely. Supports +, -, *, /, %, ^ (power), parentheses, and functions: sqrt, abs, sin, cos, tan, asin, acos, atan, log (base 10), ln (natural), exp, floor, ceil, round. Constants: pi, e. Example: 'sqrt(16) + 2^3' = 12

expression.description: The mathematical expression to evaluate, e.g. '2 + 3 * 4' or 'sqrt(144) + pi'

tools.name: text_stats
tools.description: Analyze text and return statistics: character count, word count, sentence count, paragraph count, average word length, and most frequent words.

tools.name: text_transform
tools.description: Transform text in various ways. Operations: uppercase, lowercase, titlecase, reverse, trim, remove_duplicates (remove duplicate lines), sort_lines, count_substring (requires 'pattern' param), replace (requires 'pattern' and 'replacement' params).

pattern.description: Pattern for count_substring or replace operations

tools.name: unit_convert
tools.description: Convert between units of the same category. Categories: length (mm, cm, m, km, inch, in, ft, yard, yd, mile, mi), weight (mg, g, kg, ton, t, oz, lb, pound), temperature (C, F, K), data (bit, byte, KB, MB, GB, TB). Example: convert 100 from 'cm' to 'inch'.

tools.name: datetime_info
tools.description: Get current date/time, format a date, or calculate the difference between two dates. Operations: 'now' (current date/time, optional timezone), 'format' (format a date string, requires 'date' and 'format' params), 'diff' (difference between two dates, requires 'date' and 'date2' params). Date format: ISO 8601 (e.g. '2024-01-15') or natural language. Format string uses: YYYY, MM, DD, HH, mm, ss, dddd (day name).

timezone.description: Timezone for 'now' operation, e.g. 'Asia/Shanghai', 'America/New_York'. Defaults to UTC.

date.description: Date string for format/diff operations (ISO 8601 or parseable date)

format.description: Format string for format operation, e.g. 'YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm:ss'

tools.name: random_gen
tools.description: Generate random values. Operations: 'number' (random int in range, requires 'min' and 'max'), 'uuid' (UUID v4), 'password' (random password, optional 'length' and 'uppercase'/'symbols' flags), 'pick' (pick N items from a list, requires 'items' array and optional 'count'), 'shuffle' (shuffle a list, requires 'items' array).

items.description: Array of items for pick/shuffle operations

count.description: Number of items to pick for 'pick' operation (default 1)

tools.name: run_agent
tools.description: Run a ReAct agent that can autonomously use all available tools to complete a task. Supports multi-step tasks with LLM or rule-based mode.

task.description: The task for the agent to complete

tools.name: run_workflow
tools.description: Run a multi-step DAG workflow. Define steps with dependencies; runs them in order. Each step is an agent task.

steps.description: JSON array of workflow steps: [{id, task, dependsOn?, label?, timeout?}]

tools.name: deep_research
tools.description: Run a deep research workflow on a question. Breaks down the question, searches for each sub-topic, and produces a comprehensive report.

tools.name: remember
tools.description: Store a memory (fact, preference, task, or conversation) with tags for later recall.

tools.name: recall
tools.description: Recall memories by tags. Returns the most relevant memories matching the given tags.

tools.name: memory_stats
tools.description: Get memory statistics: total count and breakdown by type.

tools.name: extract_skill
tools.description: Extract a reusable skill from a completed task. The agent learns how to handle similar tasks in the future.

exampleTask.description: An example task this skill handles

tags.description: Comma-separated tags for matching new tasks

tools.name: list_skills
tools.description: List all extracted skills, sorted by use count.
